title: Inspection results report availability and never credential material
statement: The presented result contains provider display names, exact model identifiers and present-or-absent for the research credential, and is asserted to contain no key, token, header, environment value or credential-derived fingerprint. No external service is contacted during the inspection.
notes: PASS 2026-09-21 on EVD-0125. The granted result holds provider display names, exact model IDs from getAvailable() and present-or-absent for the research credential, and nothing else; getAll() is never called, and a provider whose status alone says configured is not listed. No network attempt was made and no credential value, header or credential field reached the result. LIMIT: this is configured availability under Pi's registry. No provider request was made or shown to succeed. CI run 35648974488 passed the tests in all four cells.
